game_title: Phone Book Rescue – Blizzard Saddle Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle, a saddle between peaks: the mountaineer must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Phone Book Rescue: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change.
theme: Frost Peaks – Blizzard Saddle: a saddle between peaks
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Saddle, repeat each round: Add and update dictionary entries as contacts change. Each round, crevasse ghouls strike the pass gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the contacts value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the pass gate from crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle: keep the contacts meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: contacts drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Phone Book Rescue
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Phone Book Rescue' (Week 8 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Blizzard Saddle'. region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how contacts changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Blizzard Saddle.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while contacts > 0.
